design.advance: Preserve every useful known-edit location and human flag count. Verify every selected context against original decoded HTML ranges. Zero authorship confidence weight.
design.controls: Six held controls per unsupported structure: no quote, interleaved quote, styled text, unmarked quote, malformed nesting and unsupported markup. The second check must abstain on every control.
design.formats: Re-encode 308 earlier measured plain replies with 2, 3, 5, or 6 body paragraphs as HTML-only MIME. Use explicit trailing blockquote, inline emphasis, and alternate base64/quoted-printable transfer encoding. Keep decoded text exactly the same.
design.measure: Replay only identical ordered primary contexts and complete per-reply second-check requests. Any source, text, request, or selected location mismatch fails.
